title: Resolve answer
description: The body of the adapter's signed 200 answer to the call with the path resolve (resolve.schema.json), application/json: one result for each address of the call, in the call's order. The control plane refuses an answer whose results do not name the call's addresses one for one, in that order, as the schema cannot say. The answer is signed with the adapter's access key, bound to the call's signature, as definitions.schema.json describes an answer to a call, and names the revision it was built for in revision. The control plane refuses a member this schema does not define.

version.description: The document format. The control plane refuses a version it does not read.

revision.description: The contract revision the adapter built the answer for, the one the call's X-Qory-Contract-Version named. The control plane refuses an answer whose revision is not the call's.

results.description: One result for each address of the call, in the call's order.

result.description: The result for one address: grant_ref and resource_ref, the grant and the resource at the source that cover it; or covered: false, when the adapter cannot read the address or no grant it holds covers it, and then neither ref.

address.description: The address, exactly as the call wrote it.

grant_ref.description: The grant that covers the address, as the adapter reported it (grant.schema.json).

resource_ref.description: The adapter's ref to the resource at the address, stable for that resource. The control plane compares it and stores it, and never reads meaning into it.

covered.description: false: no grant the adapter holds covers the address.
